quotes.text: I’ve been a member of Events and Adventures for about 7 years. I highly recommend it! It is so well worth the cost, great people and great times. The trips are amazing and always well organized. I’m excited about E&A being in Florida!

E&A has been nothing but a positive influence on my life. I have met so many great people and have made lifelong friendships. The events are well organized and give you plenty of opportunities to meet people and grow relationships.

Moving to the Seattle area from Illinois almost two years ago, I had no friends or close family here. I joined Events and Adventures to make friends and explore my new surroundings. I have not regretted my choice since

Good place to meet single people. I have been a member since 2016 and have enjoyed all the different activities they have to offer. It has been a real life changer for me after my divorce. Always something fun to do.

It is a great club. I have met so many wonderful people and had some amazing adventures with them. I have been to Mardi Gras in New Orleans, skydiving, knife forging, camping and many many more things.
This is a great resource to meet people. I moved to Vancouver right as the pandemic hit. This has been a great way to not only make friends but to meet singles without the hassles of online profiles.
